audit: garden_route_motion_v8 attack sixth-round final full semantic audit
decision_rule: All 1440 current attack PNGs were visually reviewed in per-plant sheets against all eight same-direction idle frames, adjacent directions and mirror directions. Graft 1/3 were additionally reviewed frame by frame at enlarged resolution and verified as exact mirrors. A direction fails for identity/organ/structure/palette drift, incorrect face visibility or action axis, invalid multi-peak timing, forbidden external effects, transparency/crop/guide damage, or unstable base contact. Any failure requires regenerating the whole six-frame source group.

global_checks.inventory: pass: 1440 attack PNGs, 1920 idle PNGs and 240 attack manifests present
global_checks.visual_coverage: pass: all 240 directions and all 1440 attack frames reviewed against idle, adjacent and mirror directions
global_checks.identity_consistency: pass: organ counts, leaf/petal counts and colors, silhouette, proportions, expressions and head/body structure remain coherent
global_checks.direction_semantics: pass: N and rear diagonals do not expose invalid frontal faces; S remains centered; horizontal and diagonal action axes match labels
global_checks.single_peak_logic: pass: each direction shows one anticipation-release-recovery cycle without a second attack peak
global_checks.transparent_holes_and_body_completeness: pass: no erroneous holes, missing body parts or alpha damage found
global_checks.canvas_edges: pass: zero nontransparent outer-edge pixels in all 1440 attack frames
global_checks.guide_grid_background_residue: pass: no blue/magenta/orange guides, grid lines or opaque source background found
global_checks.external_effects: pass: no forbidden projectile or water/fire/wind/electric/spore/beam/sound effect found
global_checks.base_registration: pass: no unstable base contact or disguised anchor correction found
global_checks.pixel_and_semantic_mirrors: pass: mirror pairs preserve both pixel structure and direction semantics

focus_review.evidence: All six frames retain three leaves with stable colors and positions (upper dark green, left yellow-green, right red), a narrow light-brown neck/trunk, one right-facing side eye and paired forked root-feet. Attack f0 bbox is 82x83 versus idle f0 88x84. Frames 1-2 compress, frame 3 is the sole SE forward peak at 99x75, and frames 4-5 recover with a stable root baseline.

Exact horizontal pixel mirror of direction 1 in every frame. The three leaves, narrow light-brown neck/trunk, one left-facing side eye and paired forked root-feet remain intact. Attack f0 bbox is 82x83 versus idle f0 88x84; frame 3 is the sole SW forward peak and frames 4-5 recover.
